scope: Read-only independent source, focused-test receipt, integration-diff and last-boundary-hunk review; no paid/GPU execution.
findings: The early screen requires explicit allow_model_change=false and a current source/run/round-bound, complete 20-update original capture with a full initially trainable catalog and every full update set. Unknown, incomplete, already frozen or mismatched evidence does not become a rejection.

Only explicit selected-description intent to stop updates or combine freezing with optimizer exclusion is screened. Existing negation and conservative conditional, quoted/rejected, evaluation/inference/validation-only, temporary and completed-training exemptions avoid claiming unrelated actions reduce training updates.

The final hunk permits a clear completed-training qualifier before an action while keeping bare after training end-anchored. The new leading After training finishes negative is present. This only narrows early screening; existing runtime coverage remains authoritative.

The issue enters the existing MODEL_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN validation-repair path and bounded metadata context. No diagnosis flag is rewritten by the host, no third diagnostic request is added, and the existing 2000-token, policy, numeric and runtime gates are retained.

Both patch-prompt additions are generic literal-source JSON quote examples; each fragment parses to exactly one Python source line retaining its literal double quotes. No source unescaping, scenario recipe or candidate result is introduced.
